summary: Compare strategic options, test assumptions and produce decision briefs through practical exercises. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Data-driven strategic decision-making uses structured evidence to compare options and explain a recommendation. Designed for strategy analysts, business planners and functional leaders, this foundation-level course helps you frame choices with PESTLE and SWOT, assess source quality, test assumptions with decision trees and Excel sensitivity checks, and document review triggers and follow-up dates in a concise decision brief. Scenario analysis is covered at an introductory level.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course is designed for professionals who shape, analyse or explain strategic choices and need a practical way to connect evidence with recommendations.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with workplace objectives, performance measures and spreadsheet navigation is useful. No coding is required; exercises use Excel for simple calculations and sensitivity checks.
